# Scientific & UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Evolution Population Simulator

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of scientific simulation rules and single-view hexagonal UX requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [simulation-engine.contract.md](../contracts/simulation-engine.contract.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all 5 visual layers of a hexagonal cell (biome/topography, resources, $K/K_{\max}$ health ring, deme clusters, and 6-edge directional flow vectors) explicitly specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are all 18 base catalog items (7 Decisions, 6 Biological Traits, 5 Cultural Traditions) and their mutual exclusions or cultural prerequisites documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Data-Model §3]
- [x] CHK003 Are the initial configurations, map radii, and expected emergent outcomes defined for all 3 Scientific Presets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK004 Are all 4 permanent panels of the single-view interface and their interactive responsibilities specified without requiring page navigation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are the exact deterministic thresholds for Phase 4 milestones ($N = 8$ generations with $P_i \ge 0.35$ for Baldwin assimilation, $\ge 1.0$ for cultural innovation, and $M = 10$ isolated generations with $\ge 30\%$ divergence for allopatric speciation) unambiguously quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK006 Is the rule for demographic fission (minimum viable migrant group $\ge 10$, target hex passability, trait inheritance, proportional energy transfer, and local counter reset) clearly specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK007 Is the Jaccard distance formula ($1 - \frac{|T_A \cap T_B|}{|T_A \cup T_B|} < 0.10$) for automatic same-lineage deme fusion explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK008 Are the canonical 6-axis biophysical vector field names (`metabolicCost`, `extractionEfficiency`, `ecologicalImpact`, `spatialMobility`, `socialCohesion`, `transmissionThreshold`) consistent across `constitution.md`, `spec.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK009 Do the Evolutionary Game Theory interaction rules (Hawk-Hawk mutual penalty, Hawk-Dove resource capture via `socialCohesion`, and Symbiosis bonus + horizontal cultural diffusion) align between `spec.md` and `simulation-engine.contract.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK010 Are requirements defined for cultural erosion during demographic collapse ($\ge 50\%$ single-turn loss or population $< 50$ losing the highest-threshold cultural tradition)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is the behavior specified when a terrestrial hex cell with resident demes is submerged by sea-level rise or player terrain editing? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are demographic saturation limits ($\le 3$ demes per hexagon) and peaceful migration exclusion rules clearly specified? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK013 Can the 30-generation preset fidelity requirements in `SC-001` be objectively verified via automated deterministic tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Are the turn resolution and rendering latency targets ($< 100\text{ ms}$ biophysical/render, $< 3\text{ s}$ cognitive evaluation for 60–150 cells and 15 demes) quantified and measurable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK015 Is the requirement for live causal transparency (normalized probabilities summing to 100% plus contextual justification in the Inspector) verifiable on every turn? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Are the default English (`en`) language requirement and 100% translation coverage across the 8 major world languages (`en`, `es`, `zh`, `fr`, `de`, `pt`, `ja`, `ru`) specified and measurable? [Completeness/Measurability, Spec §FR-015, §SC-006]
